summary: Understand the nuances of Defined Benefit vs. Defined Contribution Plans through our expert-led training course. Boost your financial acumen now!
lede: Defined benefit and defined contribution plans differ in how retirement benefits are determined and who carries investment and longevity risk. This course is for HR, compensation and benefits, finance, and pension decision-makers assessing or redesigning workplace retirement benefits. It explains funding and investment basics, supports comparisons of cost, risk, and employee value, and helps participants interpret actuarial information and communicate trade-offs to staff and leadership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly engage with retirement benefit decisions, even if they are not technical pension experts.
audience: HR managers and HR business partners
Trustees and board members of pension funds
Union representatives, staff association leaders, and employee
outcomes: DB To DC Plan Conversion Analysis
modules: Deep Dive into Defined Benefit (DB) Plans
Deep Dive into Defined Contribution (DC) Plans
Comparing DB and DC: Cost, Risk, and Value
Funding, Investment, and Actuarial Basics for Non-Specialists
Plan Design Strategies: Hybrid, Cash Balance, and Reform Options
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of HR and finance concepts. No advanced knowledge of pension schemes is required.
